attchmntText: Zenith Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Zenith Exports Limited published extracts of its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in Business Standard and Arthik Lipi on November 14, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 13, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of Rs. 65 lakhs, compared to a net loss of Rs. 14 lakhs in the same period last year. Earnings per share were Rs. 0.20, up from Rs. (0.14). Total income from operations was Rs. 1,432 lakhs. Kusum Industrial Gases Ltd also filed results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, showing a net profit of Rs. 76.93 lakhs, compared to Rs. 172.08 lakhs in the previous year. Achmeers Finance Ltd reported a net profit of Rs. 234.87 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to Rs. 158.78 lakhs in the prior year. Punjab National Bank announced e-auctions for secured assets in North 24 Parganas on December 3, 2026.

attchmntText: Zenith Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Zenith Exports Limited approved its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 13, 2026. The company reported a net profit of 49 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a net loss of 11 lakhs for the half year ended the same date. Total revenue from operations stood at 1,432 lakhs for the quarter and 2,861 lakhs for the six-month period. Earnings per share were 0.91 for the quarter and 0.20 for the half year. The results were reviewed by statutory auditors M/s. V. Goyal & Associates, who issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were identified.
